record.question: Economic goods are
options: All commodities that are limited in quantity as compared to their demand
Commodities that is available according to their demand
Commodities that is available more as compared to demand
record.explanation: Answer A: All commodities that are limited in quantity as compared to their demand. Economic goods are scarce relative to demand; the first option expresses this conventional scarcity criterion. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/money/economic-good. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
